description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeSkillAPI class, which is part of the OrangeHRM project. The tests cover CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions for employee skills management within the API.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPITest
classes.description: This class contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeSkillAPI, testing functions such as getOne, getAll, create, update, delete, and their respective validation rules within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeSkillService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee skill record via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the rules for fetching a single employee skill.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee skill record.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the rules for updating an employee skill.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting an employee skill record.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee skill record.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the rules for creating an employee skill.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of employee skills.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the rules for fetching all employee skills.
